rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for something frightening or intimidating.

example.jyutping: go2 zek3 gau2 go3 joeng2 gei2 haak3 jan4

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase when emphasizing that something is really alarming or scary.

example.jyutping: tiu4 san1 man4 zan1 hai6 dak1 jan4 geng1

rows.note: Choose this when the frightening quality is especially intense or has a horror-like feel.

example.english: The scenes in that horror film are terrifying.
example.traditional: 套鬼片啲畫面真係恐怖。
example.jyutping: tou3 gwai2 pin2 di1 waa2 min2 zan1 hai6 hung2 bou3
